description: Clip dim ROW contract. `clips[i].raw["dim"]` is the share of the way to black the device draws a clip's picture at: 0.01..1 in hundredths, each encoded pixel times 1 - dim. Python (app.kria.clip_dim) and Swift (ClipDim) must each turn every `valid` value into `normalized` (null = the key is omitted from the row and the recipe clip has no `dim`), and reject every `invalid` value. A value is rounded to hundredths BEFORE the range check, so 0.004 is no dim and 1.004 is black. A percent (40) is not a strength.
